title: Routes
description: <design>/routes.json (scripts/CONTRACTS.md 6.2): the routes the checks render and the feature ids each one shows as data-feature roots. At most one route is the first view (first: true); lib/routes.mjs defaults to [{path:'/', name:'home', first:true, features:[]}] when the file is absent.

path.description: Path from the site root, without query or hash (record mode adds ?record=1).

first.description: true on the route whose first viewport is the first-screen contract.

features.description: Requirement ids rendered on this route as data-feature roots.

states.description: UI states the route must also render for the checks (for example empty, error, pending).
